remarks: LOCATION, LOW-MAINTENANCE LIVING & MOVE-IN READY CONVENIENCE! Welcome to Bell Tower Condominiums, a well-maintained community offering an easy lifestyle in a fantastic Lancaster location. This inviting second-floor condo features 2 bedrooms, 1 full bath, and 882 square feet of comfortable living space, with all appliances included! Enjoy the perks of condo living without the hassle of exterior maintenance. The HOA covers lawn care, snow removal, lawn treatments, common area maintenance, insurance, pool maintenance, water, and cable TV, making for easy, low-maintenance living. Residents also enjoy access to the community inground pool and walking path, plus the added convenience of ample basement storage. Just a short walk from Como Lake Park, you’ll have easy access to beautiful outdoor space and year-round recreation, while nearby shopping, restaurants, and major commuter routes make everyday errands and travel a breeze. Whether you're a first-time buyer, looking to downsize, or ready to simplify your lifestyle, this condo offers an excellent opportunity to enjoy comfortable living with less maintenance! No offer deadline — offers will be considered as they come in.
